text:
Clara (Support): FYI — GreenLeaf Labs says they submitted a PO last week but just got a dunning email and their org was suspended. They have a live demo tomorrow morning and are escalated. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/123456. Invoice `INV-2026-089`. Can Billing check and hold suspension if PO is on file?

Luis (Billing): CLARIFY: did they send the PO to payments@redwood.ai or to their AE? I don't see a matching PO in our system for INV-2026-089. Need PO number/scan or payment remittance to mark as received.

Clara (Support): They attached a PDF to the support ticket — snippet pasted here: ```PO#: GL-98765
Total: $5,200.00
Billing contact: ap@greenleaflabs.com
Issue date: 2026-02-25``` They say AP emailed it to sales@greenleaf.ai (the AE).

Aisha (Sales): I spoke to their AE earlier. AE confirms they received the PO via email but didn't forward to payments because AP asked AE to confirm SOW first. Contract has a PO-acceptance clause but we typically allow a short grace for signed POs. Can Billing please accept the PO scan and put an internal hold? Customer needs access for demo.

Luis (Billing): If AE has the signed PO we can mark the invoice as "disputed - PO pending" and put a temporary hold on dunning. Please have AE forward the PO PDF to payments@redwood.ai with subject `PO GL-98765 / INV-2026-089`. I can create a 48h manual hold once we get the email.

Ben (Infra): If you need them unblocked now for the demo I can flip a temporary enable (2 hours) from infra side, but we log that as an emergency exception. Need approval from Billing in-thread.

Luis (Billing): Approve temporary enable for 2 hours for demo at 2026-03-05T14:00Z, on the condition AE forwards PO to payments@redwood.ai in the next 2 hours. I'll also add an internal note and disable auto-dunning for this invoice.

Clara (Support): Copying AE and Sales ops steps to customer in ticket. Also sending the quick repro for support if anyone needs to confirm suspension state: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/greenleaflabs/suspension` returns `{"suspended": true, "reason": "dunning"}` — infra toggle is `/admin/orgs/greenleaflabs/unsuspend --duration 2h`.

dunning-bot: Automated notice sent: INV-2026-089 -> dunning email #3 (2026-03-04 09:12:07 UTC).

Aisha (Sales): AE has now forwarded the PO to payments@redwood.ai and replied in the ticket with the forwarded email. AE also confirmed AP will remit by EOD.

Luis (Billing): Received PO email. Marking invoice as `disputed/PO-received` and creating a hold: `/billing hold INV-2026-089 --reason "PO on file, awaiting remittance" --expires 2026-03-07T09:00Z`. Will remove suspension flag in our system and note collections team. Confirm when infra unblocks.

Ben (Infra): Unblocked org for 2 hours as approved. Audit ID: infra-audit-77821. Logged exception to org history.

Clara (Support): Customer updated and very relieved. Sales to follow up on remittance. Closing loop: if payment not received by 2026-03-07 we resume standard dunning. :thumbsup:
